definitions.name: S0B.KEEP
definitions.body: 'M' BIND 'X' BIND X NIL M SELECT [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: vector mask -> the elements of vector whose mask lane is TRUE

definitions.name: S0B.COUNT
definitions.note: boolean vector -> number of TRUE lanes

definitions.name: S0B.STARTS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND 0 V LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE 'I' BIND V 0 GET 1 SUB 1 COLLECT V -1 DROP CONCAT 'P' BIND I V P GT NOT V P LT NOT AND NOT S0B.KEEP
definitions.note: non-empty vector of numbers -> indices where a run of equal adjacent values starts

definitions.name: S0B.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE 'J' BIND N J DIV 'Q' BIND J Q Q FLOOR SUB 0 GT NOT S0B.KEEP
definitions.note: positive integer -> ascending Vector of its divisors

definitions.name: S0B.PASS
definitions.note: string -> string with every () and [] pair deleted once

definitions.name: S0B.REDUCE
definitions.body: S0B.PASS S0B.PASS S0B.PASS S0B.PASS S0B.PASS S0B.PASS
definitions.note: bracket string (<=12 chars) -> string left after deleting matched pairs until none

solutions.runs.rle: 'V' BIND V S0B.STARTS 'ST' BIND V ST GET ST 1 DROP V LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT ST SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'V' BIND V 0 GET 1 SUB 1 COLLECT V -1 DROP CONCAT V 2 COLLECT ZIP 0 [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 1 E 1 GET E 0 GET GT SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'R' BIND R KEYS NIL R VALUES 2 MUL V LENGTH GT SELECT SORT 0 GET
solutions.number.primes: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ S0B.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
solutions.number.binary: 'N' BIND 0 6 RANGE 'K' BIND 2 K POW 'P' BIND N P DIV FLOOR N P 2 MUL DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB 'B' BIND B P N GT NOT S0B.KEEP REVERSE STR JOIN
solutions.number.collatz: 'N' BIND 1 130 RANGE N [ 'E' BIND 'X' BIND X 3 MUL 1 ADD X 2 DIV X 2 DIV X 2 DIV FLOOR SUB 0 GT SELECT 'NX' BIND 1 NX X 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN 'T' BIND N 1 COLLECT T CONCAT 1 SUB 0 GT S0B.COUNT
solutions.number.digital_root: 'N' BIND N N 1 SUB 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB
solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 '([)]' C SEARCH 2 LT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: 'S' BIND 0 S CHARS LENGTH RANGE [ 'L' BIND S CHARS L TAKE JOIN S0B.REDUCE CHARS LENGTH 0 EQ ] MAP 'M' BIND 0 S CHARS LENGTH RANGE 0 M SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
